p: seeing I have rejected him from: Signifying that we should not show ourselves more pitiful than God, nor to lament those whom he casts out.
to sacrifice to the LORD: That is, to make a peace offering, which may be done even though the ark was not there.
trembled at his coming: Afraid, lest some grievous crime had been committed, because the prophet was not wont to come there.
anointed is before him: Thinking that Eliab had been appointed by God to be made king.
evil spirit from the LORD troubled: The wicked spirits are at God's commandment to execute his will against the wicked.
son of Jesse the Bethlehemite: Though David was now anointed king by the prophet, yet God would strengthen and test him in various ways before he had the use of his kingdom.
refreshed: God would have Saul receive this benefit from David's hand, that his condemnation might be even more evident, for his cruel hate toward him.
